prompt: Each user's post ids must be readable newest-first, and new posts arrive at any moment. Which structure stores the feed?
explanation: A list fits naturally: LPUSH puts each new post id at the head, and LRANGE 0 9 reads the ten newest without any sorting step. A set loses order, a hash has no sequence, and a sorted set would only be needed if posts had scores to rank by.

options.text: A list per user, prepending each new post id with LPUSH
A set per user, adding each post id with SADD
A hash per user, one field per post
A HyperLogLog per user counting the posts
